item.title: About
item.description: Hey, I’m Somto — a Software Engineer focused on Cloud DevOps and Backend systems. I’m based in Nigeria and I spend most of my time building things that (hopefully) don’t break in production. I work at the intersection of infrastructure and backend engineering — Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, distributed systems, and all the fun stuff that happens between writing code and having it actually run reliably at scale. The “wannabe cracked dev” part is genuine.
